csv_project_name: DB for New Downtown Parking Deck
csv_scope_of_work: Town of Huntersville, NC (the Town ) is soliciting qualified Design-Build teams to provide professional design, construction, and contract administration services for a downtown parking deck project (the Downtown Parking Deck ). The proposed Downtown Parking Deck will be a multi-level, double-ramp parking deck with standard parking stalls and EV Charging Stations. The completed project aims to accommodate sufficient parking for Town employees and visitors, as well as public parking for downtown businesses and events. It will also serve future transit users for a planned commuter rail stop in downtown Huntersville. Parking dimensions shall meet current county and municipal standards and ADA requirements. The Design-Builder will be expected to provide pre-construction, design, construction, construction administration, and post construction turnkey activities for this project resulting in a finished, fully usable parking facility that satisfies all project requirements and contract terms.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Design Build/Developer, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
